verdict.rationale: Rollbar's notification system fires actions automatically on error events. It sends real-time alerts to messaging and incident tools, creates, updates and resolves PagerDuty incidents, and pushes webhooks on the same triggers as its other channels. The evidence never describes the rule definition itself (conditions, filters, thresholds), and the actions shown are limited to notify or push, not broader automated actions inside Rollbar. Missing for 10: documentation of configurable rule conditions and filters, a list of trigger event types, in-product automated actions (e.g., auto-assign or auto-resolve), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Rollbar supports email and many messaging and incident management tools where your team can get notified about errors and important events by real-time alerts.
Webhooks can be sent for the same triggers as our other notifications channels
Rollbar can create, update, and resolve Incidents in PagerDuty.
Rollbar provides real-time alerts through the project-level Notifications menu.
